commands.name: local_wheel_ground_speed_observability_audit

decision_rule: Test whether physically cleaner wheel inputs, Romega_i plus independent v_parallel_i, provide self-identification information that the rejected M91 front/rear raw proxy did not.
failure_criteria: actor profile includes slip_ratio or tire saturation labels
v_parallel is derived from wheel-speed average instead of independent ego-motion fusion or simulator local contact speed
Romega plus v_parallel does not improve future envelope probes over the no-wheel baseline
wheel profile weakens wrong-history counterfactual evidence
hypothesis: The M91-I no-wheel result rejected the current front/rear proxy, not wheel sensing in general. A cleaner Romega plus local ground-speed profile may improve handling-envelope observability without feeding slip diagnostics.
success_criteria: new profiles distinguish Romega-only, Romega plus v_parallel, and optional v_perp without slip ratio
P0 no-wheel baseline is preserved for comparison
future braking yaw lateral envelope probes are reported
decision states whether wheel/local-ground-speed signals can re-enter PPO-facing profile comparison
